8. With identical L and identical sum, the TM-score = (1/L)*sum is identical for P and Q. [O4]

9. Conclusion: Under the conditions of identical native structures and identical lengths, the TM-scores of P and Q to any fixed reference structure R are identical. [O1,O4]
